mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.5% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% in a 3-month window signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of UNRATE >5.0% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad consumer demand weakness, forecasting negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns positive in >55% of HOUST/RSAFS decline periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing contraction (INDPRO < 100) intensifies supply chain disruptions, reducing corporate profits and forecasting negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns positive in >55% of INDPRO < 100 periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without thresholds.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns negative in >55% of GDPC1 positive growth periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation, triggering central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns positive in >55% of CPIAUCSL yoy >2.5% periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment decline (UNRATE) indicate labor market tightness, boosting consumer spending and forecasting positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >55% of PAYEMS rise/UNRATE fall periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Active monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising >0.25% monthly) increases discount rates and reduces liquidity, forecasting negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns positive in >55% of FEDFUNDS rise >0.25% periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.
